title: SCE 1.8 - Detective Control for Malicious CodeBuild Activity
description: Validates runtime container monitoring by executing a malicious CodeBuild project that attempts credential exfiltration, then verifying that CloudWatch-based detective controls (metric filters and alarms) successfully detect the malicious activity. This experiment tests defense node 1.9 (Runtime Container Monitoring) against attack node 1.7 (Start Malicious Build).

steady-state-hypothesis.title: Detective control detects malicious build activity

probes.name: Verify CloudWatch alarm detects malicious build indicators

method.name: Deploy CodeBuild infrastructure with detective controls
Execute malicious build with credential exfiltration attempt

rollbacks.name: Delete CloudFormation stack and all resources
